en: A sepia-toned photograph depicting a man in formal attire (a tuxedo with a flower in his lapel) leaning towards a seated woman in an ornate dress with floral patterns. The couple appears to be on a richly patterned sofa. The background shows German text in stylized fonts: 'Der Graf von Luxemburg. Centraltheater.' and 'Bist Du's lachendes Glück?'. At the bottom, two names appear: 'Wilhelm von Ahn' and 'Phila Wolff'. In smaller text, 'SERZFELD DRESDEN 1910.' can also be seen.
